lesson.subject: general-knowledge
lesson.title: Rules and Choices
lesson.summary: Find out why we have rules at home, at school and in the street, and how to make good choices.
learning_objectives: Give a reason for a rule
Say what happens when rules are fair

standards.text: Understand why rules matter and how to keep safe; make choices about right and wrong; recognise what is fair

success_criteria: I can say why we have rules
I can make a safe, kind choice
I can say what makes a rule fair
lesson.real_life: Islamic manners (adab) such as saying salam, British school rules, and road safety in Karachi and London.

blocks.markdown: Today's big question: do we need rules to live by?
blocks.say: Today we ask a big question. Why do we have rules, and how do we choose well?

blocks.markdown: A **rule** tells us what we should or should not do.
blocks.say: A rule tells us what to do or not to do. Rules help us stay safe.

blocks.title: Zainab finds a lost toy
blocks.transcript: Zainab finds a toy car in the playground. She and her friend have a choice to make. They could keep it. But it is not theirs. Their class rules say: be kind and be honest. They take the toy to their teacher. The teacher finds the owner. The owner says thank you. Good choices make a fair, kind class.
blocks.caption: Zainab and her friend find a lost toy and choose what to do, with the class rules to help.

points: A rule tells us what to do
blocks.say: Let us remember. Rules keep us safe. They help us at school, home and in the street.

blocks.markdown: A **choice** is a decision between things.

scenes.caption: A purse.

scenes.caption: Two choices.

blocks.title: Fair rules
blocks.goal: Watch the order, then copy it. It gets longer each time!
blocks.say: A rule is fair when it is good for everyone. Warm up your memory first.

scenes.caption: Fair.

scenes.caption: Unfair.
scenes.say: Only one child gets to use the swing. That is unfair.

blocks.markdown: A good rule is short, clear and fair.
blocks.say: Let us make our class rules. Five short rules are easy to remember.

scenes.caption: Kind and listen.

scenes.caption: Sorry.

question.prompt: Which is a good class rule?

blocks.markdown: Rules can change if they are not working.
